dedupe_keys.name: cicos hydrological information system of the congo basin sih

description: The Hydrological Information System (SIH) of CICOS, the international commission of the Congo-Oubangui- Sangha basin, is a key part of the Congo Basin Information System (SIBCO). It is an operational system for monitoring water resources that uses conventional in situ data and data from space technologies, integrating satellite altimetry with the collection, archiving and display of in situ data. CICOS describes it as a reliable and up-to-date hydrological database for developing operational services in hydrology and space technology, built on open, modular and interoperable technology so the commission can develop downstream services itself, and shared by CICOS experts and water actors in the basin. To reach the database, users send a request to CICOS by email, obtain an account and log in at the SIH web address. Access is on request with an account; no licence or cost is stated. Caveats: the data cannot be seen without an account, and station numbers and periods are not given on the page read. Coverage is the Congo basin (Cameroon, Central African Republic, Republic of Congo, Democratic Republic of the Congo). It supports hazard exposure analysis of river levels for inland navigation, ports and hydropower; the related record is the CICOS inland navigation infrastructure pages.
